login.title: LIBRYNO - Login
login.auth_required:
⚠️ OrdoB account required.
Without it, Libryno won't work.
Sign up at ordob.com/cadastro
login.no_account_info: Don't have an OrdoB account? Create one for free at ordob.com/cadastro, then come back to sign in.
login.create_account_info:
Create your free account at:
https://ordob.com/cadastro

After signing up, return to Libryno and sign in.
login.error:
Invalid email or password.
Check your OrdoB credentials.
login.server_unreachable:
OrdoB server unreachable.

Libryno requires a connection to the OrdoB API to work.
Check your internet and try again.
login.exit_confirm:
Do you really want to exit?

Libryno requires authentication to work.
login.browser_auth_info:
1. Open OrdoB in your browser and log in
2. Copy the API token from the settings page
3. Paste the token in the dialog below

Callback URL:
{callback_url}

Or use the email/password form on the left.
login.browser_auth_timeout:
Timeout.
Please sign in again via email/password or try browser login.
